name: Boomerang Survivor
summary:
This is an action game where you control the main character, Maple, and defeat enemy characters on the screen to survive.

The only action you can perform is throwing a boomerang, but the movement is a bit unique.
You can use the fact that the thrown boomerang returns to Maple to your advantage to launch a variety of attacks.

Overcome the increasingly fierce attacks of the enemy and aim for a high score!
